note: Social Reels — separated from YouTube. Each reel ≥60s (1800 frames @30fps). If licensed track shorter, we render to track length and log need-full-song. AI slides / new stock only — no people-mids from uploaded TikToks.

reels.headline: The Storm Didn't Come to Drown You
bodyLines: The storm came to show you who calms it.
Peace is not the absence of waves.
It's the presence of His voice over them.
Keep rowing — He is in the boat.

reels.headline: You Are Not Late — You Are Becoming
bodyLines: Your chapter 3 is not their chapter 10.
Stay the course — consistency beats intensity.
Your time is not late. It's being formed.
